overview: This is an Administrative Law Judge's order dated July 15, 2022, in ITC Investigation 337-TA-1270 concerning Certain Casual Footwear and Packaging Thereof. The order denies respondent Quanzhou ZhengDe Network Corp. (d/b/a Amoji)'s motion for partial summary determination of non-infringement for its alternative footwear designs.

points.point: Respondent Quanzhou ZhengDe Network Corp., d/b/a Amoji filed a motion on June 10, 2022 for partial summary determination of non-infringement with respect to certain ZhengDe alternative footwear designs.
points.quote: On June 10, 2022, Respondent Quanzhou ZhengDe Network Corp., d/b/a Amoji ("ZhengDe") filed a motion (Mot. 1270-057) for partial summary determination of noninfringement

points.point: The motion raised whether ZhengDe's alternative footwear designs were ripe for adjudication and, if so, whether they infringed the asserted patents.
points.quote: In determining whether there is a genuine issue of material fact, "the evidence must be viewed in the light most favorable to the party opposing the motion"

points.point: The Administrative Law Judge denied ZhengDe's motion for partial summary determination.
points.quote: For this reason, Motion Docket No. 1270-057 for partial summary determination is DENIED.

points.point: The ALJ found there were genuine issues of material fact as to whether the alternative footwear designs met the four-factor test for ripeness for adjudication established in the Oligosaccharides case.
points.quote: There are genuine issues of material fact as to whether the alternative footwear designs are ripe for adjudication.

points.point: The ALJ identified that Crocs disputed three of the four ripeness factors: whether the alternative designs had been imported, whether they were sufficiently fixed in design, and whether they were sufficiently disclosed during discovery.
points.quote: Crocs disputes three of the four factors – namely, whether the alternative footwear designs have been imported, whether they are sufficiently fixed in design, and whether they were sufficiently disclosed

points.point: Under the applicable test from Certain Human Milk Oligosaccharides and Methods of Producing the Same, Inv. No. 337-TA-1120, a respondent must show: (1) whether the product is within the scope of the investigation; (2) whether it has been imported; (3) whether it is sufficiently fixed in design; and (4) whether it has been sufficiently disclosed by respondent during discovery.
points.quote: The test for determining whether a respondent has met its burden for adjudication of a redesigned or alternative product includes four factors: "(1) whether the product is within the scope of the investigation; (2) whether it has been imported

rejected.point: The alternative footwear designs remain subject to adjudication on the merits; the disputes over ripeness factors proceed to the hearing.

title: Denying Respondent Quanzhou ZhengDe Network Corp., d/b/a Amoji's Motion for Partial Summary Determination of Non-Infringement for Alternative Designs
